sentences.text: The company sells goods and services within design and craftsmanship - and other activities that naturally fall under this - as well as participation in other companies, investments and related business.
NOVOOI AS is a private limited company (AS), registered in Oslo, founded 2021-05-09.

According to Enhetsregisteret, its main registered industry is industri-, produkt- og motedesignvirksomhet (NACE 74.110; division: Other professional, scientific and technical activities); its registered activity reads: "Selge varer og tjenester innen design og håndverk - og annet som naturlig sammenfaller med dette - samt deltakelse i andre selskaper, investeringer og nærliggende virksomhet.".
Its verified official website is https://novooi.com/.
The website describes the business as: "Curated Norwegian interior design shop and agency, for professionals and conscious consumers. Showroom in Oslo. Global shipping." (company-reported).
In its latest normalised company accounts (period ending 2025-12-31) it reported revenue NOK 541 thousand, operating result -NOK 2.2 million, annual result -NOK 2.2 million, equity NOK 508 thousand.
Revenue was up 192% from NOK 185 thousand in the period ending 2024-12-31.
Registered leadership: Daglig leder: Lillian Ayla B Ersoy; Styrets leder: Peter Torgeir Nylund.
It has 1 registered workplace(s) in Oslo.
Most recent dated company news: "Design Dialogues Afterwork" (2026-10-07).
